verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The new sibling dependency is pinned at both the workflow sparse-checkout seam and SELF_TEST_LIVE_INPUTS. All `gh api` GETs are routed through the shared bounded retry layer without widening it to mutations, and exhausted reads remain fail-closed. The diagnosis change is narrowly scoped to the repository metadata read, whose failure cannot itself establish a protected-setting defect; environment-read failures and evaluated settings defects retain the full remediation. The self-test is non-vacuous: it counts actual subprocess attempts, proves a retry recovery reaches the verified path, checks failure transport/status without exposing stderr, exercises malformed successful metadata, and includes inverse/scoping cases that preserve real findings. No reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
